policy.purpose: Record external grants and donations accepted by the project, and make the independence rules inspectable before money is accepted.
policy.independenceLine: No funder may buy ranking placement, coverage, scoring treatment, source treatment, guide copy, endorsements, user data, private analytics, or roadmap control.
policy.noStringsAttestation: Accepted support may fund time, outreach, validation, documentation, hosting, and public-interest maintenance only. It cannot influence facts, scores, ranking order, category inclusion, app copy, or user data access.

publishedCaps.rule: Decline money from any brand, platform, product maker, service provider, fund, charity, or affiliate that is rated or likely to be rated by a Values Commons lens.
Decline any money conditioned on coverage, ranking, score changes, source treatment, guide wording, data access, private reporting, or roadmap control.
Amounts above this cap must be declined or recorded as a public pledge before acceptance, with the reason and independence terms visible in this ledger.

whoFundsUsLens.reason: No external funder entries are recorded in this repository snapshot, so a scored who-funds-us lens would invent data. Missing means omit until real accepted funders exist.

limitations: This ledger records external grants and donations accepted by the project. It is not a personal expense ledger.
An empty entries array means no external grants or donations are recorded in this repository snapshot; it is not a claim about future funding.
